scope: Official source facts only; no market quote, forecast, valuation, or selection.

frozen.question: Danaher (DHR) Q3 non-GAAP core revenue growth 3% to 4.5%?
frozen.rule: Metric = Danaher non-GAAP core revenue growth YoY for Q3 2026 as in official company materials. Subsequent revisions excluded; if earnings materials exist but metric absent -> lowest bracket; if none by Nov30 2026 23:59 ET -> lowest. Exact midpoint between brackets -> higher bracket. If metric reported as range, use midpoint. Use most numerically precise version; exclude versions differing in definition/scope. EndDate 2026-10-21T13:30:00Z (09:30 ET).

result_material.publisher: Danaher Investor Relations official Q3 results page, HTTP200. Headline/date: “Danaher Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results”; Washington, Oct21 2026.
result_material.quarter: Q3 2026, quarter ended September25, 2026; YoY comparison is comparable 2025 period.
result_material.bracket_title: 3% to 4.5%; reported value is at the named bracket lower bound, shown to 0.1 percentage point.

distinctions.Q3_table_note: A positive respiratory-testing impact is a YoY headwind. Release table: three-month period ended Sep25 2026 vs comparable 2025 period.
distinctions.tariff_refund_change: The same release says beginning with the Q3 Form 10-Q, core sales growth and core growth excluding respiratory testing exclude, if any, tariff refunds from prior-period payments returned/to be returned to customers; its Q3 table separately lists +1.0% tariff-refund impact. Do not conflate this potential changed-definition figure with the 3.0% release metric.

result_material.not_target: Q4 2026 forward guidance is separate from Q3 actual; release forecasts total core sales growth about +3.0%, core excluding respiratory 4–5%, respiratory headwind about 150bp. Not used as Q3 result.
